nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $\ell$, the vertices of the Grassmann graph $\mathrm{Gr}(k, \ell)$ are the $\ell$-dimensional linear subspaces of $\mathbb{F}_2^k$.
nodes.title: Vertices of the Grassmann graph

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $\ell$, the Grassmann graph $\mathrm{Gr}(k, \ell)$ has as vertices the $\ell$-dimensional linear subspaces of $\mathbb{F}_2^k$, and two distinct such subspaces $L$ and $L'$ are adjacent when $\dim(L \cap L') = \ell - 1$.
nodes.title: Grassmann graph over $\mathbb{F}_2$

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $\ell$ and linear subspaces $A$ and $B$ of $\mathbb{F}_2^k$, $\mathrm{Gr}(k, \ell)[A, B]$ is the finite set of vertices $L$ of the Grassmann graph $\mathrm{Gr}(k, \ell)$, that is of $\ell$-dimensional subspaces of $\mathbb{F}_2^k$, with $A \subseteq L \subseteq B$. If $A \not\subseteq B$ the set is empty.
nodes.title: Grassmann vertices between two subspaces

nodes.title: Non-expanding sets in the Grassmann graph (Khot–Minzer–Safra)

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$ and let $S \subseteq V$ be nonempty. Let $d$ be the degree in $G$ of a fixed vertex of $S$, chosen once for each $S$. The expansion of $S$ is the rational number $\Phi_G(S) = |E(S, V \setminus S)| / (d \cdot |S|)$, where $E(S, V \setminus S)$ is the set of edges of $G$ with one endpoint in $S$ and the other in $V \setminus S$; it is $0$ when $d = 0$.
nodes.title: Edge expansion of a vertex set

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
